content.english: Shine my precious one, sing in awe.

content.hebrew: אֶל יָהּ תְּהַלֵּל לוֹ : כֹּל הַנְּשָׁמָה
content.transliteration: El yah tehallel lo : kol hanneshama
content.english: Let all that breathes praise Yah!

content.hebrew: כִּי בָא זְמַן רָצוֹן : אוֹרָה שְׁלֵמָה
content.transliteration: Ki va zeman ratson : ora shelema
content.english: When the auspicious moment arrives, the perfect light,
Go towards your joyous partner; break into song!
Awake, my precious one, beautiful and radiant.
Become one with the Sabbath day in union.
Understand your essence, your cistern and your well.

content.hebrew: שִׁיתִי לְבָבֵךְ בִּין : סוֹד רָז חֲבֵרֵךְ
content.transliteration: Shiti levavech bin : sod raz ḥaverech
content.english: Pay attention; discern the enigmatic secret of your mate [God]!
You will know the essence of the Rock, the Creator of your form,
For He in His oneness exists constantly.
Awake, my precious one, beautiful and radiant.
Become one with the Sabbath day in union.
Run, O anointed Lady of the reign!
Stop your chariot from all work.
The sunset is approaching; it is time to begin the blessing.
The Sabbath is being placed, similar to a honeybee!
Awake, my precious one, beautiful and radiant.
Become one with the Sabbath day in union.
Today is holy, the most important of days:
You will triumphantly bring [our] bodies into perfection!
“The sanctification of both of them is a sign,” declared the Sages.
“Spiritual delight, preserved in the World-to-come!”
Awake, my precious one, beautiful and radiant.
Become one with the Sabbath day in union.

content.hebrew: מָ֒תְנֵךְ בְּעֹז חִגְרִי : הַלֵּל לְצוּר כֹּל
content.transliteration: Motnech be‘oz ḥiḡri : hallel letsur kol
content.english: Gird yourself with strength and praise the Rock of everything.

content.hebrew: חִקְרִי בְּסִפְרֵי דָת : לִדְבַּק אֱלֵי כֹל
content.transliteration: Ḥiḳri besifré dat : lidbaḳ elé chol
content.english: Study the books of faith and be devoted to it all.
Follow the path of understanding of Heman and Calcol.
Brace your intelligence [with] pure knowledge.
Awake, my precious one, beautiful and radiant.
Become one with the Sabbath day in union.

content.hebrew: בָּ֒רְ֒כִי לְאֵל כִּי הוּא : אוֹרִי וְיִשְׁעִי
content.transliteration: Barechi le’el ki hu : ori veyish‘i
content.english: Bless God, for He is my light and my salvation,
Who chose Israel and sanctified the seventh [day].
The mystical meaning of resting on it—an allusion in my mind,
A witness to the innovation of everything, the miracle of creation!
Awake, my precious one, beautiful and radiant.
Become one with the Sabbath day in union.
Dress, O perfect one, in the glory and the crown of faith!
Be inculcated with the secrets of the Sevens!
Strive to graze in the Garden!
Your portion is forever safe in the eternal life.
Awake, my precious one, beautiful and radiant.
Become one with the Sabbath day in union.
Be gathered up, my soul, the perfect bride
Teem with your work; whisper upwards:
The Fiery Law in your studies; devotion to the law—
Pray to the Rock; He will have mercy on the exiled congregation.
Awake, my precious one, beautiful and radiant.
Become one with the Sabbath day in union.
O Merciful One, raise up the horn of those that sit restfully,
Observing the Sabbaths and joyfully reading.
May they merit the concealed good, the benefit of rest:
May they forever delight in the luminous splendor.
Awake, my precious one, beautiful and radiant.
Become one with the Sabbath day in union.
Strengthen Your awesome one and redeem Your flock,
Lead and settle them in Your city,
Build Your holy house, complete Your Temple,
Set Your glory [there]; we shall see the light.
Awake, my precious one, beautiful and radiant.
Become one with the Sabbath day in union.

content.hebrew: כַּכָּתוּב: כִּֽי־עִ֭מְּךָ מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים בְּ֝אוֹרְךָ֗ נִרְאֶה־אֽוֹר
content.transliteration: Kakkatuv: Ki ‘immecha meḳor ḥayyim be’orecha nir’é or.
content.english: As it is written: With You is the fountain of life; by Your light do we see light. (Ps. 36:10).
